pythonFunction.name: start_rebate_claim
pythonFunction.description:
Records a rebate claim request (a mock intake for the demo) for one published program and returns the
claim number and the tracker steps. Needs an identified caller and the customer's clear yes to the program.
Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    program_id: Id of the program from find_rebates, for example md_furnace or va_thermostat (REQUIRED).
    equipment_note: Short note on the equipment the customer bought or plans to install.
    contractor_name: Name of the participating contractor, when the customer knows it.
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, claim_id, program_name, amount, status, steps, card (the show_claim_status_card arguments),
    next_steps and agent_action.
